objectives.objective: AUTO: start with up to eight supported FUEL and score from a legal launch pose while the HUB is active
objectives.basis: The starting fold holds 14 or more FUEL by free volume behind the stowed intake (start-capacity premise), and the hopper-cycle-8-preload trial feeds eight from the hopper; the launch and flight cases carry a FUEL into the HUB opening from the 2.7 m pose that the re-run rehearsal credits in AUTO (delivery-pose premise). Delivering from 2.70 m costs no FUEL: slot 2 credits 124 in both the baseline and R3 series.

objectives.objective: Inactive shift: collect and hold the next allocated stock from the DEPOT, OUTPOST or a partner
objectives.basis: The acquire cases take a floor FUEL up the bumper face and the chute back plate and over its top along the acquisition trial's trace (inside the frame in 0.65 s); the hopper and stage cases follow the entry trial to the stage, clamped under the feeder roller 1.44 s later. The hopper-collect-24-hold trial collects 24 through the chute: 24 in the hopper and 0 in the chute, none lost and none at the flywheel (hopper-capacity premise).

objectives.objective: Active shift: carry each FUEL from storage through one transfer into the HUB
objectives.basis: loaded-transit, the launch cases and the flight cases carry the tracked FUEL from the stage into the HUB cavity along the launch and delivery trials' traces. The feeder advances it only with the wheel in its ready band; it releases at 6.90 m/s and 61.6 degrees, and the delivery trials score from 6.725 to 7.100 m/s at the nominal drag and spin lift and at all four corners.

objectives.objective: Active shift: sustain 2.00 FUEL/s to score 24 with stock ready by second 5
objectives.basis: The batch trial launches 24 FUEL through the one flywheel at 4.0 FUEL/s, every release inside the scoring band, on a 12 V and on the 8.34 V weak-pack bus. The hopper cycle trial feeds 24 collected FUEL to the flywheel in 7.1-10.5 s over 16 arrival patterns (2.3-3.4 FUEL/s against 2.00), so the hopper, not the flywheel, sets the rate. The wheel spins up in 1.1 s (1.3 s on the weak pack) and is held at speed while FUEL is aboard. Bench tests are listed in verification-gates.json and in the risk register of missions.json.

objectives.objective: Fallback: score the available batch when supply or traffic consumes the window and return to collecting
objectives.basis: The cycle is piece-count independent: the hopper-cycle-8-preload trial feeds a part batch; the intake stays deployed in every scoring case; the re-run rehearsal keeps the depot loop.

objectives.objective: Traffic: remain in the own zone, keep possession through loaded driving and contact, and yield
objectives.basis: The hopper front is closed by the deployed intake's back plate to 425 mm and the walls rise to 715 mm. Every collect-hold-feed pattern carries its 24 FUEL through a 0.5 g stop, start and turn with none lost. Harder stops are tested on single patterns only: at 0.75 g 1 of 1 tested patterns keep and feed all 24; at 1 g 2 of 2 tested patterns keep and feed all 24. Loaded acceleration is limited to 0.5 g. The staged FUEL is clamped under a braked feeder roller: the hold trial keeps it 25.6 mm clear of the spinning wheel at 1.5 g with a 90 N push. Bench tests are listed in verification-gates.json and in the risk register of missions.json.

objectives.objective: Neutral collector alternative with two field crossings
objectives.basis: The coordinator selected the own-zone role. R3 keeps a BUMP crossing option (bump-crossing premise, 8.7 mm least clearance) with the intake retracted.

objectives.objective: End game: Level 1 low-rung hang when its expected 10 points exceed the remaining FUEL service
objectives.basis: With the hopper empty the hooks swing forward, the intake stows between them, the robot closes on the TOWER, seats (2 mm required contact) and lifts 70 mm; the 714 mm frame gives 23.9 mm of bumper overlap with each upright (hang-bumper-overlap premise); the hang physics trial at 70.3 kg holds 37.5 mm with the brake and fails without it; its cable load peaks at 1043 N in the lift and settles at 690 N. Bench tests are listed in verification-gates.json and in the risk register of missions.json.

objectives.objective: AUTO Level 1 TOWER (15 points, two-robot cap)
objectives.basis: The strategy keeps the eight-FUEL AUTO objective; no joined AUTO climb evidence is sought in this layout.

objectives.objective: Reserve the depot entrance and partner lane
objectives.basis: Alliance routing decision owned by the field rehearsal, independent of the robot layout.

objectives.objective: Measurement: observe intake crossing, retained identity, release and downstream crossing on one timebase
objectives.basis: An entry sensor on the carriage watches the top of the chute and a stage beam watches each lane at the feeder; the HUB counter is field equipment.
